{{Quote|The idea of being this close and not seeing it, and I know we can't all be up there, but I fear morale might be crushed by having anything more than an essential roster down here tomorrow night.|The corporal, to Gorn, regarding the Eye|<ref name="The Axe Forgets">{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}}</ref>}}
A [[human]] served as a '''corporal''' in the [[Aldhani Garrison]] as part of the [[Low Road Unit]].<ref name="The Eye" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[corporal]] first appeared in "[[The Axe Forgets]]," the fifth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was directed by [[Susanna White]]. [[Dan Li]] portrayed the character and was credited as Corporal #1.<ref name="The Axe Forgets" />
